summary: Build an app with role-based post-login routing (admin dashboard vs user form) and a header that displays the logged-in user's ID.
architectural_notes: Implement role-aware post-login routing: admin -> admin dashboard (users list + reports), user -> user form page.
Add a persistent header component that shows the authenticated user's ID.
known_issues: Admin accounts are currently being routed/rendered as normal users (admin sees form page instead of admin dashboard).

existing_features.title: Display the currently logged-in user's Internet Identity principal (user ID) at the top of the app for both normal users and admins, visible after login on all authenticated screens.

new_feature_requests.summary: Fix role-based routing so admin accounts do not see the user form page and instead see admin views (all users list and reports).
Display the logged-in user's ID at the top of the app after login for both users and admins.

projectName: Show logged-in user ID in the app header
